description: MDCOVID-19 Total Currently Hospitalized Adult and Pediatric Acute and ICU is published by Maryland Department of Health Prevention and Health Promotion Administration, MDH PHPA. The series records adult and paediatric acute-care and ICU COVID-19 occupancy. Its stated coverage is Maryland, United States; statewide daily totals. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. The provider deprecated the dataset on 10 October 2025. For simulation, it can inform health-service demand, capacity and disruption scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-simpy-streamlit-healthcare-des provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
